title: HR Metric Definition Dictionary
description: Structured contract for HR metric definitions - calculation formulas, data sources, refresh cadence, and ownership per metric - consumed by the hr-metrics-analysis skill (Execution Steps 1 and 3) and the data-analyst agent. Closes docs/variant-benchmark-backlog.md section 12 'No metric-definition dictionary' (gap closed 2026-08-25).

scope.description: Engagement or project scope the dictionary covers, e.g. 'FY2026 workforce baseline diagnosis'

definition.description: Plain-language definition of what the metric measures

formula.description: Explicit calculation formula, e.g. 'separations in period / average headcount in period (voluntary split)'

data_sources.description: Systems of record, e.g. 'HRIS payroll export', 'ATS requisition report'

owner.description: Role accountable for data quality and refresh

iso_30414_area.description: ISO 30414 reporting area link when the metric maps to one - see docs/iso-30414-metrics-mapping.md, areas 1-11

benchmark_guardrail.description: External-benchmark citation requirement note; benchmarks must cite source name and recency per skill Step 4
